title: Todo list app with filters and saved tasks
when: The user wants a todo list, task list or checklist app to add, check off, edit and delete tasks that stay after a reload.
prompt: Goal: A fast task list where adding, completing, editing and filtering work by mouse and keyboard and nothing is lost on reload. Steps: 1. Model a task as { id, text, done, createdAt } in one array; ids from crypto.randomUUID(). 2. logic.mjs pure functions returning new arrays: addTask (trims, rejects empty), toggleTask, editTask, removeTask, clearDone, filterTasks(list, all | active | done). 3. Form with a labeled text input and a submit button; Enter adds, the input clears and keeps focus. 4. Each task is an li with a checkbox, its text in a label, Edit (Enter saves, Escape cancels) and Delete with an aria-label naming the task. 5. Filter buttons with aria-pressed and a "3 tasks left" counter in an aria-live="polite" element. 6. Save to localStorage key tasks.v1 after each change inside try and catch; on load parse in try and catch and fall back to []. 7. test.mjs with node:assert: add (empty rejected), toggle, edit, remove, every filter. Quality bar: - Task text goes in with textContent, so hi shows literally. - Every action works by keyboard with visible focus. - Long task text wraps at 375 px. Pitfalls: - Rebuilding the list from an innerHTML string. - Focus lost after delete; move it to the next task or the input. - Saving only on page unload. Verify: - [ ] Reload keeps tasks and done state. - [ ] Spaces-only text adds nothing. - [ ] Counter sits in an aria-live region. - [ ] node test.mjs passes. Output: index.html, style.css, app.js (DOM and storage), logic.mjs (pure task functions), test.mjs.

examples.input: faz um app de lista de tarefas que salva no navegador
examples.output: form + list with checkboxes, filters All/Active/Done, "2 tasks left", tasks.v1 in localStorage
